148862.overview:
Hit the slopes! With ski jumps, icy runs, and slalom scoring, this frosty table brings winter competition to the playfield.

Produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1978, Winter Sports is a classic solid-state pinball machine. It features an Olympic-style theme with artwork depicting various cold-weather disciplines like skiing. 

The table is known for a relatively simple but challenging layout that emphasizes precise nudging and target completion.

178166.overview:
World Cup Soccer is a pinball game by Williams Electronics (under the Bally label), designed by John Popadiuk and released to promote the 1994 World Cup.

As far as pinball goes, the table pretty accurately emulates the World Cup experience - you buy tickets, fill the stadiums with fans, and most importantly shoot goals. In addition, you move through the various cities the Real Life teams went to, and eventually take on the top contender (Germany) to become champion.

448375.overview: Wild West Rampage is one of two original pinball tables in the Iron and Steel pack, released in 2015 as an add-on for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. This table chronicles the exploits of Cindy, a seasoned bounty huntress who fights for justice in the deserts of the American Wild West with her fists and a trusty revolver.

448388.overview: World War Hulk is one of the four Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Avengers Chronicles Pack, released in 2012 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. The table is based on the eponymous 2007 comic book series in which an enraged Hulk, exiled into space by fellow superheroes to keep him from endangering others, returns with an army to wreak vengeance on them.

456243.overview:
Wallace & Gromit is a British claymation comedy franchise created by Nick Park and produced by Aardman Animations. The series centres on Wallace, a good-natured, eccentric and cheese-loving bachelor inventor, and Gromit, his loyal and intelligent anthropomorphic dog.

First released in 2006 for Visual Pinball 8, the Wallace and Gromit pinball table is heavily inspired by the classic shorts A Grand Day Out and The Wrong Trousers, and features audio by Peter Sallis, the original voice actor for Wallace.

The table was ported to Future Pinball in 2015, and Visual Pinball X in 2025.

463552.overview: Wimbledon is a tennis-themed, Brazilian pinball table released in 1978. It is a copy of Gottlieb's 1975 machine, Volley.

468527.overview:
Outlive the dead to climb the leaderboards! The zombie horde forced your group to hide and you are now stuck in the overrun Central Mall. Score big and roll through hordes of Zeke to help the survivors escape this forsaken place.

World War Z is the first new table to release following the early access launch of the Pinball FX reboot. Taking inspiration from the New York story of the eponymous video game, the player takes part in a war against the "Zekes", zombies affected by a mysterious pathogen.

468555.overview: Wolverine is one of the first four Marvel pinball tables released in 2010, initially released for Pinball FX2. Based on the iconic Marvel mutant, this table challenges the player to fight against four of Wolverine's deadly adversaries.

468563.overview:
Loosely inspired by the works of author H.P. Lovecraft, the table challenges players to put an end to an Eldritch god only known as "It".

Wrath of the Elder Gods is one of the new Zen Originals, initially released in early access for Pinball FX on the Epic Games Store on November 17, 2022. It later received a wider release on other platforms, including a Steam release on April 13, 2023. 

The table received an updated port with audio & art adjustments as "Wrath of the Elder Gods: Director's Cut", and was released as the free trial table for the company's spinoff, Pinball M, on 30 November, 2023.

468579.overview:
The Walking Dead is a standalone licensed pinball adaptation of the first set of "episodes" of Telltale Games' The Walking Dead video game series, set in the universe of Image Comics' The Walking Dead comic books. Released in the late summer of 2014, this table recaptures the events of all five "episodes" of The Walking Dead: Season One, in which Lee Everett, a hardy survivor of a zombie apocalypse, discovers a young girl named Clementine and must stop at nothing to protect her from both the dangerous Walkers at the core of the conflict as well as hostile individuals, while being forced to make difficult decisions to survive.

This is the second pinball table to be based on The Walking Dead franchise; the first one is a physical table developed by Stern that adapted portions of AMC's television adaptation of the comic series.

469423.overview:
A forest fantasy! Enchanted woods, nature spirits, and mysterious creatures await in this fairy-tale themed adventure.

Released in 1976 by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria, Wood's Queen is a classic electro-mechanical pinball machine known for its vibrant jungle fantasy aesthetic and straightforward, challenging gameplay.

It features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, a six-bank of drop targets, and seven standup targets. Players can choose to focus on the standup targets or the drop targets. Lighting all standup targets activates a "roving special," while completing the drop target bank multiple times increases their point value from 500 to 10,000 points and eventually awards a "special".

470308.overview:
Wayne and Garth have transformed a cellar into a television studio and host a music program broadcast on a local cable network each night. An ambitious television producer, seduced by their unbridled style, decides to give them their first big chance.

A digital pinball table created for Visual Pinball featuring plenty of audio samples from the 1992 Mike Myers movie and the original soundtrack as background music.

470438.overview:
Nature's majesty in full bloom! Enchanting forest creatures and mystical woods charm every shot.

Wood's Queen 2019 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1976 electromechanical Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2019 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470566.overview: Based on Stern's 2001 physical pinball table "Monopoly", this is an enhanced homebrew version for Visual Pinball X with original graphics based on World of Warcraft characters.

471234.overview:
The Wacky Races digital pinball table is a popular custom virtual pinball creation that brings the chaotic Hanna-Barbera cartoon to life. Designed with a 1990s Data East aesthetic, the table focuses on high-speed, ramp-heavy gameplay that mirrors the racing theme of the show. 

It was created by Dave Sanders (aka Eala Dubh Sidhe) in 2003. It has been iterated on since, and versions exist for Visual Pinball 8, Future Pinball, and Visual Pinball X. The most recent version was released by remdwaas1986 for VPX in 2023.

471298.overview:
Released as the free to play table for Zen Studios' Pinball M, Wrath of the Elder Gods: Director's Cut is an enhanced version of a table first released as DLC for Pinball FX. 

The Director's Cut features more mature content, turning the table into more of a horror theme. You'll notice blood splatter on the flippers and slingshots, different sideblade art, and skulls on the slingshot targets. Colours are more vibrant, and Cthulhu's model has also been changed to a reddish hue compared to the original purple/black version.

471813.overview:
Homebrew table for Visual Pinball X based on the 1986 graphic novel by Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons, published by DC Comics. Table features a soundtrack including 80s classics such as Tainted Love, Blue Monday, Two Tribes, Enola Gay and Everybody Wants To Rule The World.

RULES:

• RORSCHACH: Hit the left drop targets to light Rorschach modes. Hit the center saucer to start Rorschach modes. During Rorschach modes, hit orange lights.
• NITE OWL: Hit the left ramp to light and start Nite Owl modes. During Nite Owl modes, hit white lights.
• OZYMANDIAS: Hit the spinner to light and start Ozymandias modes. During Ozymandias modes, hit purple lights.
• SILK SPECTRE: Hit the right ramp to light and start Silk Spectre modes. During Silk Spectre modes, hit yellow lights.
• DR MANHATTAN: Hit the right saucer behind the right drop targets light and start Dr Manhattan modes. During Dr Manhattan modes, hit blue lights.
• WIZARD MODES: Complete modes for all characters to light wizard modes.
• OWLSHIP MULTIBALL: Hit loops lit with green lights to light lock. Hit ramps to lock balls. During multiball, hit green lights.
• SUGAR CUBES: Collect sugar cubes to light extra ball, light mystery, and light "X" at the inlanes.
• "X": Roll over the lit X inlane to multiply the value of your next shot.
• MYSTERY: Hit red arrows on the upper playfield to light a mystery award at the center saucer.
• DOUBLE SCORING: Hit turquoise targets on the upper playfield to light double scoring at the upper playfield hole.

471864.overview:
SLAMT1LT's mod of Roney's 2013 original table for Future Pinball. The aim of the table is to play through the famous album by completing all the chapters.  Hit the Advance Chapter Target a set number of times to advance to the next chapter.

• Martian Multi-ball: Open the Mulit-Ball door and then lock 3 balls in the top right kicker to initiate the 4-Ball Martian Multi-ball.  Hit the Heatray Chamber to get the Jackpot during this mode.

• Heatray Chamber: Knock down all the targets in the Heatray Chamber to get the Extra Ball and Special.

• 4-Bank Tripod Targets: Hit all 4 drop targets to gain the following rewards:
 - 1st time awards 4,000
-  2nd time awards 10,000
-  3rd time awards 20,000
-  4th time Lites Extra Ball in Left and Right InLanes.
-  5th time Lites Special (250,000) in Left and Right OutLanes.

• Mars Attacks Targets: Hit the centre targets to gain extra award targets.  Knock down all award targets to lite the Extra Ball. 

• Martian Super Jets: Hit the left lane 5 times to activate the Martian Super Jets.  While active each bumper scores 1500 points.

• War: Light W-A-R to increase the Bonus Mulitplier.

472354.overview:
As part of a deal with Bally, FarSight Studios licensed the 1994 table World Cup Soccer for inclusion in their Pinball Arcade game. However, FIFA were in an exclusive deal with EA regarding using World Cup branding in a video game. Consequently, FarSight had to change the name of the table to World Champion Soccer, and make a number of changes to the table artwork so it could be included in Pinball Arcade.

This digital table has many changes; the W-O-R-L-D-C-U-P lights leading to the left loop are replaced by C-H-A-M-P-I-O-N, World Cup USA 94 on the plastics between left in-lanes and out-lanes are renamed to Champion Soccer TPA 17. The backglass was also changed to avoid possible lawsuits from FIFA for using the tournament's mascot Striker, World Cup USA 94 name and any other references to World Cup USA 1994 without the required license.

472963.overview: An enhanced version of Stern's 1978 Wild Fyre, released for Future Pinball in 2012. The mod includes music, sound effects and audio callouts from the Russell Crowe movie, Gladiator.

474088.overview: Wanted is an original Future Pinball table by creator Francisco666 based upon the 2008 American action thriller film starring James McAvoy, Morgan Freeman, Terence Stamp, Thomas Kretschmann, Common, and Angelina Jolie. The film revolves around Wesley Allan Gibson (McAvoy), who decides to join the Fraternity, a secret society of assassins, after learning that his father was a member of the Fraternity.

478519.overview: WipEout Pinball is a highly praised Future Pinball tribute to the classic PlayStation futuristic racing franchise. Created originally in 2012 by homebrew developer Drakko, the table has since received several DOFLinx updates to optimize the table for physical pinball cabinets, adding real-world haptic feedback to enhance the experience.

480034.overview: Wonder Woman is an original table for Future Pinball based on the DC Comics superhero. Released by Chaos in 2012, the table later received a mod by NitroNimbus improving the game by changing the playfield art, lighting, sound, and most importantly of all, adding a full length version of the excellent original 1970s TV series theme music.

481370.overview:
World Cup Soccer: NitroNimbus MOD is a Future Pinball version of the officially licensed World Cup Soccer (Bally, 1994). 

The mod has updated the table with the latest BAM physics, and added tasteful crowd images to the sideblades. Aside from this minor addition, the table is a very faithful arcade-style recreation of a classic pinball machine.
